verdict.rationale: CMS IndusLaw has a documented Employment & Pensions practice covering "all aspects of employment law including litigation, transactional and advisory matters" and "structuring of compensation and benefits." It also publishes an Employment Newsletter, which implies employment documentation work but never names hiring paperwork. missing for 10: explicit mention of drafting offer letters, employment agreements, or invention-assignment/confidentiality agreements; any IP-assignment-in-employment evidence; independent or hands-on corroboration.
